components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled control on a screen: New session, submit, Trust and connect.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #4cc9ff; color: #0a1226; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #22b5f2; filter: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fd9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A translucent light fill for the second action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); color: #f2f0fb; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fd9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Terminate, delete: a danger stroke that fills on hover; isolated by 2rem of leading space.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; margin-inline-start: 2rem; border: 1px solid rgb(255 138 152 / 0.55); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #ff8a98; font: 600 0.8125rem/1.125rem "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #c9304b; border-color: #c9304b; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fd9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A dark well with a light line, lit by the accent on focus; label above, help beneath.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 24rem; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font: 600 0.8125rem/1.125rem inherit; color: #f2f0fb; } .ds-field-help { font: 400 0.8125rem/1.125rem inherit; color: #aba7cb; } .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.36); border-radius: 10px; background: rgb(12 10 24 / 0.55); color: #f2f0fb; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem inherit; caret-color: #4cc9ff; transition: border-color 120ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #aba7cb; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #4cc9ff; outline: 2px solid #7fd9ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.css: .ds-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 264px; font-family: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 12px; color: #f2f0fb; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-row-followed, .ds-row-followed:hover { background: rgb(76 201 255 / 0.14); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(76 201 255 / 0.55), 0 0 22px -6px rgb(76 201 255 / 0.55); } .ds-lamp { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-lamp-connected { background: #3ddc97; } .ds-lamp-action { background: #ff5fae; } .ds-row-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-label { font: 600 0.8125rem/1rem inherit; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row-target { font: 400 0.75rem/1rem inherit; color: #aba7cb; } .ds-row-time { font: 500 0.75rem/1rem "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #aba7cb; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7fd9ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Termdock is used in dim rooms, at night, next to near-black terminals. The interface is a cabin at cruise: the room is dimmed to a deep violet-navy with a faint magenta and violet glow at two frame edges, every working surface is a translucent card lit from within (a faint white fill and a 1 px light line), and one cyan reading light marks the seat you are in: the session you follow. Everything else that carries meaning is a small lamp beside its word: green, blue, amber, magenta, red or slate for session state, never for decoration.

The system refuses two category defaults. It is not the neon hacker console (near-black, glowing edges, monospace as a costume): the terminal keeps its own near-black pane and the chrome around it is calm, sentence-case and proportional. It is not the white SaaS dashboard either (grey ground, blue buttons, a card for everything): there is one ground, one accent, and cards hold forms, tables and overlays, never the page's structure.

Density is operator density on a compact fixed scale: 48 px session rows, 36 px navigation rows, 32 px tabs, one or two type sizes per component with hierarchy carried by weight and ink level. Motion is two crisp steps on an exponential ease-out (120 ms to recolour or press, 180 ms to move) and stills completely under reduced motion. Dark only (plan D-26).
keyCharacteristics: One ground (#171431) with two static edge glows; opaque near-black panes (#0c0b16) for terminals.
Translucent cards: white at 4.5 % with a 1 px white line at 9 % and 16 px corners.
One accent, sky cyan (#4cc9ff): primary actions, selection, focus and the followed session.
Magenta (#ff5fae) means attention: Action required and bells, nothing else.
Plus Jakarta Sans, sentence case, 400 / 500 / 600; JetBrains Mono only for codes, keys and fingerprints.
The reading light: the followed session's fill and cyan ring travel with it from row to tab to pane.

rules.name: The Reading Light Rule
rules.body: The accent owns selection: the followed session, the active tab, the focused pane, the highlighted palette row and the chosen choice card all use accent-soft and accent-ring. Nothing else is cyan but primary actions, links and focus.

rules.name: The Lamp Beside the Word Rule
rules.body: A state colour appears only as a lamp (or the ring of a group count) and always with its state word in reach: in the group header, the chip, the tab's screen-reader text or the tile's accessible name.

rules.name: The Opaque Over Terminals Rule
rules.body: Anything drawn over a live terminal (overlay cards, the progress chip, the palette) is surface-solid with no backdrop-filter; the scrim is a flat alpha of the pane colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live value (uptime, age, count, code) is set in tabular figures so changing digits never shift.

rules.name: The Two Sizes Rule
rules.body: A row, tab or chip uses at most two sizes; rank comes from weight and ink level (ink over ink-muted), never from a third size.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears where a value is read as data or measurement (durations, counts, codes, keys, fingerprints, addresses), never as a costume for prose or labels.

rules.name: The Float Earns Its Shadow Rule
rules.body: A card at rest has a line and no shadow; only what floats over other content gets Float or Card. Never a shadow for emphasis.

dos: Do read every colour through the tokens (ink, ink-muted, line, surface, accent, the lamps); new chrome goes on the ground, new reading surfaces in a card.
Do give every session its lamp with the state word in reach, and every live value tabular figures.
Do keep transitions at the two tokens (--duration-step 120 ms, --duration-move 180 ms) on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); both drop to 0 under reduced motion.
Do draw icons from components/icons (24-unit grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps) and keep them decorative with the name on the control.
Do make anything over a live terminal surface-solid, with no blur and no gradient.
donts: Don't use a state colour for anything but session state, or magenta for anything but attention.
Don't move the followed row, tile or tab; it lights, it never shifts.
Don't add a second sans family, a display face, uppercase labels, or monospace outside codes, keys, fingerprints and the terminal.
Don't give a resting card a shadow, or a floating one a border heavier than line.
Don't put backdrop-filter, an animated gradient or a glow behind or over a terminal pane.
